# Q-Guard

> Q-Guard is a test automation tool by Q-Leap SA, a software testing company in
> Luxembourg. It observes how real users move through a web application, anonymises
> that data at the source, detects the journeys they repeat and turns them into test
> cases and Selenium scripts (Java, C#, Ruby, Python). It is installed on the
> customer's own servers under an annual licence that includes installation and support.

## Product

- [Home](https://q-guard.app/): what Q-Guard does and who it is for
- [How it works](https://q-guard.app/how-it-works/): from real usage to test cases and Selenium scripts
- [Features](https://q-guard.app/features/): test case generation, Selenium export, reports
- [Security & data](https://q-guard.app/security-and-data/): on-premise storage, anonymisation at the source, GDPR
- [Licence & trial](https://q-guard.app/licence-and-trial/): annual on-premise licence, installation, trial, support
- [FAQ](https://q-guard.app/support-help-faq/): licence, installation, data, trial
- [Q-Guard Test Runner](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/q-guard-test-runner/aefoifepleogeiicaclpdldfjppdpjbd): browser extension that runs Q-Guard test cases locally
